title: Top 10 AI Smart Cameras for 2027 Planning (Buyer’s Guide)
summary: Compare AI smart cameras for manufacturing by setup workflow, inspection requirements, and production validation.
body_markdown:
## Frequently asked questions


Which AI smart camera should I evaluate first for a 2027 project?


Start with the workflow and imaging requirements of the station. Overview recommends evaluating OV Spark or Spark Pro when your team wants an integrated camera with Sparky-assisted setup, then testing representative parts against your production acceptance criteria.


Does an AI smart camera need an external computer for production inference?


These product families provide on-device inspection capability, but setup, advanced model workflows, data storage, and optional services can have separate requirements. Request the architecture for the exact model and enabled features rather than assuming every function runs on the camera.


How should I choose between Spark and Spark Pro?


Choose based on the image detail needed over your required field of view. Spark Pro provides more resolution, but feature visibility also depends on the lens, focus, lighting, and motion. Test representative parts with the full recipe before selecting the camera.
